title.zh: 在打拉省Sta. Ignacia市镇san Francisco描笼涯设立一所国立中学，名称为Sta. Ignacia国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay san Francisco , Municiapalty of Sta. Ignacia, Province of Tarlac to be Known as The Sta. Ignacia National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay san Francisco , Municiapalty of Sta. Ignacia, Province of Tarlac to be Known as The Sta. Ignacia National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ san Francisco, Municiapalty of Sta. Ignacia, จังหวัด Tarlac ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Sta. Ignacia
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay san Francisco, Municiapalty of Sta. Ignacia, Provinsi Tarlac dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Sta. Ignacia
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay san Francisco, Municiapalty of Sta. Ignacia, Wilayah Tarlac dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Sta. Ignacia

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12093_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay San Francisco, Municipality of Sta. Ignacia, Province of Tarlac to be known as the Sta. Ignacia National High School..

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Sta. Ignacia National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the school's organization, administration, operations and management, in accordance with Republic Act No. 9155, or the "Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001", Republic Act No. 10533, or the "Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013", and other basic education-related laws.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
